## Publication Information

**Date:** 1901

**Genre:** Non-fiction

**Publisher:** <i>Friendly Leaves</i> (July 1901) 242-3

**Notes:** This series, 'Leaves for the Months', is identified as by CMY in the obituary in <i>Friendly Leaves</i>, April 1901. A footnote to this paper says ‘This is the last paper Miss Yonge wrote for us.’
